summary: Ryanair Holdings filed a Form 6-K on 22 June 2026 to report a transaction by a person discharging managerial responsibilities. The filing discloses that CEO Michael O'Leary was granted options to purchase 10,000,000 ordinary shares at a strike price of €26.70 under the company's 2019 Long Term Incentive Plan, subject to performance targets. The transaction occurred outside a trading venue on 19 June 2026. This is a routine equity grant notification under EU Market Abuse Regulation, not a special situation. No deal terms or corporate event are present.
